implementation: Reserve binds an exact unique live ordinary Delivered first nr56, worker, serial, CPU, native MCFK0001 marker and nonzero nonce, range/root, same OS generation, distinct child connection and referenced current Linux child TGID/MM.

Child PID/MM references and their Arc allocation precede Remote.slots acquisition. Validation, replay exclusion and transaction-token allocation precede the single child metadata publication. The MM owner retains mm_count, not mm_users, avoiding a VMA/application connection cycle.

Commit changes only the prevalidated transaction state and is unsafe/internal pending the infallible VMA transaction. No new ABI command or caller is exposed. Existing commands 1-14 and the original Mailbox methods remain byte-identical.

Original ordinary RET owns its response memory through actual wake/status publication. Positive RET must match the child PID and committed state; parent/worker close or negative completion requests cancellation. Cancellation retains the child identity/root metadata and blocks ordinary child cleanup/release. No HostRevoked or final scalar ACK is fabricated.

next_executable_check.release: Dispatcher must inspect and approve before compiler invocation; CPU7, 2GiB AS, 180s owned process group, nofile256, fsize64MiB, core0, serial Rust1.92.
next_executable_check.vectors: Five actual-body Rust tests: queued/copying/kernel/returning phase rejection; unique reserve/commit and original real RET response publication including failed wake retention; cancel-before-RET and original -512 cancellation publication; range/OS/PID/occupied-child mismatch, token and replay rejection; non-native marker/zero nonce and ambiguous Delivered rejection.
next_executable_check.adapters: Kernel Vec allocation and Linux PID/MM/OS identity are explicit fixture adapters. Exact production RPC, Request/Response and complete Mailbox bodies, ForkAdoption transitions, reservation metadata and backend reserve/commit/cancel/RET/publication helpers are extracted. Linux reference acquisition/destruction and Remote integration require native compilation/review; no live fork is tested.
next_executable_check.capture: Persistent mkdtemp under inherited TMPDIR retains generated source, binary, compiler version, every command, stdout, stderr and status, including timeouts.

remaining_gates: Non-null CREATE_PPD remains -95. No ABI15-17, VMA replacement, second-handshake, revoke, final-ACK or success gate is connected.

Live per-VMA write exclusion remains unavailable in the pinned generated Rust bindings; mmap write locking alone is not accepted. Backend reserve stays callable only internally, with no external caller.
Cancellation ownership is deliberately retained until actual host revoke/drain plus exact checked final guest destruction and scalar ACK are wired. PID absence is not a safety proof.
